an5.226:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā kulupakassa bhikkhuno ativelaṃ kulesu saṃsaṭṭhassa viharato
an5.226:1.7: otiṇṇacittassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ anabhirato vā brahmacariyaṃ carissati saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjissati sikkhaṃ vā paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissati
an5.226:1.8: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā kulupakassa bhikkhuno ativelaṃ kulesu saṃsaṭṭhassa viharatoti.
